paragraphs: You changed a C function in PHP and want to know three things before opening a pull request: is it faster than master, by how much, and is the output still the same. php-src-bench builds both versions, runs the same PHP expressions on both and prints a table you can paste into the PR.
(An excerpt; the whole table and how it was made are in reports/htmlspecialchars-ascii-fast-path.)
What it takes care of, so that you do not have to:
features: Two real builds. A and B are separate release builds of two commits, with the same
Noise. Each build is started four times, pinned to one core, in the order A B B A A B B A, so
Instruction counts (--perf), the metric php-src's own CI benchmark uses. They do not
Numbers for a pull request. bench compare measures CPU cycles per call of the same change
Correctness. For every case the value the expression returns is compared between A and B.
